invariants.rationale: It is likely that a property name to be stored in a map should be non-null and non-empty.
Since value is processed by castProperty, it is likely expected to be non-null.
The method calls properties.put, which would require properties to be non-null.
The type parameter is used in casting and may be expected to be non-null and non-empty.
Before putting a new property, it might be expected that the property is either missing or its value is null.
